## Families

A family is a group of models that Riftland asks with one prompt guide. Open its file to see its models side by side and when to pick which.

- [GPT Image](family-gpt-image.md): GPT Image 2.6 Flare, GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst, GPT Image 2.5 Flare, GPT Image 2
